author: Siebold, 1824
status: 나그네새 수천 마리 · 겨울철새 수십 마리
habitat: 산림, 숲 가장자리, 침엽수림, 도시의 정원과 공원

months.note: 해에 따라 불규칙하게 찾아오며, 3~5월 봄 이동기에 가장 많고 겨울에는 적은 수가 머문다.

summary: 우리나라에 불규칙하게 찾아오는 겨울철새로, 산림 가운데서도 숲 가장자리와 침엽수림, 도시의 정원과 공원 등지에서 지낸다. 주된 번식지는 러시아 동부의 산림이며, 침엽수 위에 나뭇가지와 지의류, 풀로 접시 모양 둥지를 짓고 검은 반점이 박힌 옅은 청색 알을 4~6개 낳는다. 한국, 중국, 일본 등지에서 겨울을 난다.

points.ko: 청회색 허리와 배, 노란 배 가운데
points.en: blue-grey rump and belly with a yellow belly centre
black tail with a red tip

young: 갓 깃이 난 어린새는 대체로 회색이고 배가 희며 옆구리에 짙은 회색 세로줄무늬가 많다. 첫겨울 어린새는 어른새와 비슷하나 아래꼬리덮깃의 붉은색이 칙칙하고 날개의 붉은 띠가 옅으며, 첫째날개깃 바깥쪽의 흰 무늬가 적거나 없다.

similar.how: 황여새는 꼬리 끝이 노랗고 첫째날개깃 끝에 노란색과 흰색 무늬가 있으며 아래꼬리덮깃이 짙은 밤색이지만, 홍여새는 꼬리 끝과 날개의 무늬가 붉고 노란색이 없다.

art.subject: Japanese Waxwing (Bombycilla japonica), adult in winter (November–March): soft pinkish grey-brown plumage with a long, pointed crest swept back from the crown; forehead, front of the crest and cheeks rich rufous-chestnut; a narrow black stripe from the bill base through the eye runs back along the rear edge of the crest to its tip; small black chin and throat patch; back grey-brown, rump grey; wings grey with black flight feathers, a dark red band formed by red tips to the greater coverts, and small white tips to the outer webs of the primaries forming a row of white marks on the folded wing; breast pinkish grey-brown, the centre of the belly pale yellow, flanks grey-brown; undertail coverts rusty-red; tail grey at the base, black towards the end, with a red tip; short black bill; dark reddish-brown eye; black legs.
art.pose: perched on a branch, side view
art.scene: Korean winter woodland edge with conifers beside a park; no people, buildings or text
views: adult, side view perched on a berry-laden twig: swept-back crest with the black eye-stripe running to its tip, rufous-chestnut forehead and cheeks, black chin, pinkish grey-brown body, pale yellow belly centre, rusty-red vent, red-tipped tail

adult, seen from behind and slightly above, perched: grey rump, grey-and-black tail with a red tip, dark red band across the folded wing, black flight feathers with a row of small white tips on the primaries
art.build: Plump, compact songbird, 18cm — clearly larger than a sparrow, smaller than a starling, with a starling-like silhouette in flight. Large head with a soft, pointed crest swept back from the crown. Bill short, black and broad-based, much shorter than the head. Legs short and black. Wings fairly long and pointed. Tail short and square-ended. Perches upright in tight flocks in treetops and feeds on berries, often hanging among fruiting twigs.
avoid: Do not paint a yellow tail tip or yellow V-marks on the primaries — those belong to Bohemian Waxwing (Bombycilla garrulus); this species has a red tail tip and only small white primary tips.
Do not stop the black eye-stripe at the base of the crest; it runs right along the crest to the tip.
Do not paint red waxy droplets on the secondaries as in Bohemian Waxwing.
Do not paint a long thin bill or long legs.
